Text:
SEPTIC ARTHRITIS (NATIVE JOINT) WITH STREPTOCOCCI
Administer parenteral therapy initially and then can be converted to appropriate oral therapy.

Duration of therapy 2-4 weeks total

References:

- Mandell chapter: Infectious arthritis of native joints
- Sanford keyword: Septic arthritis
- Up-to-date online
- Mathews CJ Lancet 2010, 375:846
Therapy:
## Treatment

[Amoxicillin 1000 mg PO tid for 14 days \($\) R](psozid2-amoxicillin-1000mg-po-tid-14days)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-amoxicillin-1000mg-po-tid-14days)

[Clindamycin 300mg PO qid for 14 days \($\) H](psozid2-clindamycin-14ds-300mg-po-qid)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-clindamycin-14ds-300mg-po-qid)
